title: Doodle to Game
user: An adult making a first tiny game with a child who needs the child’s drawings to become playable assets without learning an engine or managing art files.
smallest_useful_product: A tablet-friendly offline PWA with three fixed games (dodge, collect, top-down maze). It captures a drawing or photo of paper art, removes a simple background locally, assigns it to a sprite, and exposes only speed, score, and sound controls.
success_measure: A child and adult make a playable, personalized game in 45 minutes, with the child drawing at least two assets and changing one rule themselves.
constraints: Process camera images locally; clearly warn that background removal is best on high-contrast paper; no uploaded child artwork; accessible touch targets and undo are required.
